enchantment.minecraft.bane_of_arthropods: Extra damage to spiders, silverfish and endermites, and slows them.
enchantment.minecraft.binding_curse.desc: Cannot be unequipped until it breaks or you die.
enchantment.minecraft.breach.desc: Mace hits ignore part of the target's armor; more per level.
enchantment.minecraft.channeling.desc: Thrown trident summons lightning on a hit during thunderstorms (target under open sky).
enchantment.minecraft.density.desc: Mace smash attacks deal extra damage per block fallen.
enchantment.minecraft.efficiency.desc: Mines faster with the right tool.
enchantment.minecraft.fire_aspect.desc: Melee hits set the target on fire; longer burn per level.
enchantment.minecraft.fire_protection.de: Reduces fire damage and burn time.
enchantment.minecraft.flame.desc: Bow arrows are on fire and ignite targets.
enchantment.minecraft.fortune.desc: More drops from ores, crops and similar blocks.
enchantment.minecraft.frost_walker.desc: Freezes water under your feet into ice; no magma-block damage.
enchantment.minecraft.impaling.desc: Trident deals extra damage to aquatic mobs.
enchantment.minecraft.infinity.desc: Normal arrows are not used up (need one in inventory).
enchantment.minecraft.knockback.desc: Melee hits knock targets farther back.
enchantment.minecraft.looting.desc: Mobs you kill drop more loot and rare drops more often.
enchantment.minecraft.loyalty.desc: Thrown trident returns to you; faster per level.
enchantment.minecraft.mending.desc: Collected XP repairs this item instead of going to you.
enchantment.minecraft.piercing.desc: Crossbow arrows pass through more entities and shields per level.
enchantment.minecraft.punch.desc: Bow arrows knock targets back farther.
enchantment.minecraft.riptide.desc: Using the trident in water or rain launches you forward.
enchantment.minecraft.silk_touch.desc: Blocks drop themselves instead of their normal drops.
enchantment.minecraft.soul_speed.desc: Walk faster on soul sand and soul soil; occasional boot wear.
enchantment.minecraft.sweeping_edge.desc: Sword sweep attacks deal more damage to nearby targets.
enchantment.minecraft.thorns.desc: Chance to damage attackers, at a durability cost.
enchantment.minecraft.unbreaking.desc: Chance to not lose durability on use.
enchantment.minecraft.vanishing_curse.de: Disappears instead of dropping when you die.
enchantment.minecraft.wind_burst.desc: A mace smash launches you back up for chained attacks; higher per level.
